reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis lacks a physically sound mechanism: adding metallic HEA particles to a W-Cu composite would likely reduce thermal conductivity due to increased interfacial scattering and lower intrinsic conductivity of the HEA, and the proposed sintering temperature of 300°C is far too low to densify W-based composites.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and would decisively falsify the hypothesis by measuring thermal conductivity and mechanical properties, but the experimental design is impractical because spark plasma sintering of W-Cu at 300°C will not produce a consolidated composite.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes an intervention (adding HEA particles) that is physically counterproductive for thermal conductivity and specifies unworkable processing conditions, offering no viable path for a researcher.
